turns.teacher: Good morning children! Today we will do subtraction with bundles and sticks. First sum on the board: fifty two minus twenty seven. Try it in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, I saw you using your fingers. Tell me slowly, how did you get your answer?
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Meena, when you count back seven from fifty two, which number do you say first on your finger? Do you say fifty two or fifty one?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Come here, Meena. Here are five bundles and two loose sticks, that is fifty two. Take away one stick. How many are left now? Fifty one, see? So the first finger is fifty one, not fifty two.
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Now Meena, we need seven loose sticks but we have only two. Open one bundle. How many loose sticks do you have now?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Very nice, Meena, you opened the bundle and counted twelve sticks correctly before taking away seven.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sanaa, you have been working so quietly. Can you tell us what answer you got for fifty two minus twenty seven?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Sana says twenty five. Thumbs up if you also got twenty five.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Good. Now everybody try this one: sixty one minus thirty four. Use your bundles if you need.
turns.label: new_sum
